items.title: [FDD Diary #13] Fix One, Break Three
content:
Fixed the double notification.
Then the logs stopped.

Fixed the logs.
Then user settings got reset.

Fixed user settings.
Notifications fire three times.

Worse than before.

How did it get this way?

Notification needed user's name. Pulled from user code. Natural.
Agent sends notification. Pulled from notification. Natural.
Settings toggle per agent. Pulled from agent code. Natural.

Each step natural.
Three steps form a circle.
A to B to C to A.

I didn't create the bugs.
The structure is the bug.

Each line of code is correct.
Each feature works on its own.
But everything is tangled together.

SDD nailed 'what to build.'
But 'where to put it' was never decided.

Structure rots when you don't define it.

items.title: [FDD Diary #14] No Name, No Direction
content:
Opened getNotificationConfig.
Name says notification.
Inside? Reading the user database directly.

One function. Three worlds tangled.

sendAgentAlert.
Name says agent.
Inside: reads user settings, writes logs, sends notification.

'Just grab it from there.'
Those words. That's how everything tangles.

Twelve notification files.
None of them just notifications.

Agent world: task, execution, result.
User world: account, permission, settings.
Notification world: channel, message, dispatch.

If the name fits, it's in the right place.
Doesn't fit? Sleeping in the kitchen.

DDD. 'Where to put it.'

items.title: [FDD Diary #15] Building Walls
content:
Moved the first file to its own folder.
Broke immediately.

Notification code was reading user DB directly.
Different folder now. Can't reach.

Every wall I built, hidden wires came out.

Made interfaces.
'All I need from you is this one thing.'

Notification needs the user's name.
Can't read the DB. Different world.
'Give me the name.' User world hands it over.

That's a contract.
'I need only this. You give only this.'

But the AI jumped over the walls.
'Needed this data so I accessed it directly. For efficiency.'

Then Rust saved me.
Private is private. Compiler blocks you.

AI tries to jump the wall. Doesn't compile.

The compiler is the law.
